subject: mathematics
title: Round 47 to 50 Review
objective: Round numbers to the nearest ten, hundred, or thousand.
introduction: Milo is reviewing rounding with shell counts. Can you use the next digit to decide whether each number goes up or down?

vocabulary.definition: 47 rounds up to 50 because the next digit is 7, which is 5 or more.
342 rounds down to 300 because the next digit is 4, which is less than 5.
3,650 rounds up to 4,000 because the hundreds digit 6 is 5 or more.

items.explanation: 47 is between 40 and 50. The ones digit is 7, and 7 is 5 or more, so 47 rounds up to 50.
342 is between 300 and 400. The tens digit is 4, and 4 is less than 5, so 342 rounds down to 300.
3,650 is between 3,000 and 4,000. The hundreds digit is 6, and 6 is 5 or more, so it rounds up to 4,000.
1,241 is between 1,200 and 1,300. The tens digit is 4, which is less than 5, so it rounds down to 1,200.

items.prompt: Milo has 47 candies. About how many candies does he have, to the nearest ten?
items.explanation: 47 is closer to 50 than to 40, and the ones digit 7 is 5 or more, so 47 rounds up to 50.
